title: एकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 39 · The entry into the city and Charvaka

summary.en: The city has been decorated, and thousands of people gather to see Yudhishthira, who honours the brahmins at the gate. The rakshasa Charvaka, in the form of a mendicant, stands among them and reproaches the king, and the brahmins, by their anger, burn him to ashes.
summary.kn: ನಗರ ಅಲಂಕೃತವಾಗಿದೆ, ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಜನ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅವನು ದ್ವಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭಿಕ್ಷುವೇಷದ ರಾಕ್ಷಸ ಚಾರ್ವಾಕ ಅವರ ನಡುವೆ ನಿಂತು ರಾಜನನ್ನು ನಿಂದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರು ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಭಸ್ಮ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: नगर सजा है और हज़ारों लोग युधिष्ठिर को देखने जुटते हैं, जो द्वार पर ब्राह्मणों का सम्मान करते हैं। भिक्षु वेश में राक्षस चार्वाक उनके बीच खड़ा होकर राजा को धिक्कारता है और ब्राह्मण क्रोध से उसे भस्म कर देते हैं।
summary.te: నగరం అలంకరించబడి వేలాది ప్రజలు యుధిష్ఠిరుని చూడటానికి చేరతారు; అతడు ద్వారం వద్ద బ్రాహ్మణులను గౌరవిస్తాడు. భిక్షు వేషంలోని రాక్షసుడు చార్వాకుడు వారి మధ్య నిలిచి రాజును నిందిస్తాడు; బ్రాహ్మణులు కోపంతో అతన్ని భస్మం చేస్తారు.
summary.ta: நகரம் அலங்கரிக்கப்பட, ஆயிரக்கணக்கானோர் யுதிஷ்டிரரைக் காணக் கூட, அவர் வாயிலில் அந்தணரை மதிக்கிறார். துறவி வேடத்தில் அரக்கன் சார்வாகன் அவர்களிடையே நின்று மன்னரைப் பழிக்க, அந்தணர் சினத்தால் அவனை எரித்துச் சாம்பலாக்குகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: നഗരം അലങ്കരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ കാണാൻ ആയിരക്കണക്കിനാളുകൾ ഒത്തുകൂടുന്നു; ഗോപുരവാതിലിൽ അദ്ദേഹം ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ ആദരിക്കുന്നു. ഭിക്ഷുവിന്റെ രൂപത്തിൽ ചാർവാകൻ എന്ന രാക്ഷസൻ അവർക്കിടയിൽ നിന്ന് രാജാവിനെ ആക്ഷേപിക്കുന്നു; ബ്രാഹ്മണർ കോപത്താൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ചാമ്പലാക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.39; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
प्रवेशने तु पार्थानां जनस्य पुरवासिनः ।
दिदृक्षूणां सहस्राणि समाजग्मुर्बहून्यथ ॥

meaning.en: At the Parthas' entry, many thousands of townspeople gathered, eager to see them.

verses.text:
स राजमार्गः शुशुभे समलंकृतचत्वरः ।
यथा चन्द्रोदये राजन्वर्धमानो महोदधिः ॥

meaning.en: The royal road with its decorated crossings shone, king, like the great ocean swelling at moonrise.

verses.text:
गृहाणि राजमार्गे तु रत्नवन्ति बृहन्ति च ।
प्राकम्पन्तेव भारेण स्त्रीणां पूर्णानि भारत ॥

meaning.en: The large, jewelled houses along the royal road, filled with women, seemed to shake under their weight, Bharata.

verses.text:
ताः शनैरिव सव्रीडं प्रशशंसुर्युधिष्ठिरम् ।
भीमसेनार्जुनौ चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ॥

meaning.en: Softly and with some shyness they praised Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Arjuna and the sons of Madri.

verses.text:
धन्या त्वमसि पाञ्चालि या त्वं पुरुषसत्तमान् ।
उपतिष्ठसि कल्याणि महर्षीनिव गौतमी ॥

meaning.en: "You are blessed, Panchali, who wait on these best of men, fair one, as Gautami waits on the great sages.

verses.text:
तव कर्माण्यमोघानि व्रतचर्या च भामिनि ।
इति कृष्णां महाराज प्रशशंसुस्तदा स्त्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Your deeds are not in vain, and your observance of vows, lovely woman." So the women praised Krishna then, great king.

verses.text:
प्रशंसावचनैस्तासां मिथःशब्दैश्च भारत ।
प्रीतिजैश्च तदा शब्दैः पुरमासीत्समाकुलम् ॥

meaning.en: With their words of praise and their murmurs to one another and sounds of joy, the city was then full of noise.

verses.text:
तमतीत्य यथायुक्तं राजमार्गं युधिष्ठिरः ।
अलंकृतं शोभमानमुपायाद्राजवेश्म ह ॥

meaning.en: Passing along the royal road as was fitting, Yudhishthira reached the decorated, shining royal palace.

verses.text:
ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः पौरजानपदास्तथा ।
ऊचुः कथाः कर्णसुखाः समुपेत्य ततस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the subjects, townsmen and countrymen, came up from here and there and spoke words pleasant to hear.

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या जयसि राजेन्द्र शत्रूञ्शत्रुनिसूदन ।
दिष्ट्या राज्यं पुनः प्राप्तं धर्मेण च बलेन च ॥

meaning.en: "By good fortune you have conquered, king of kings, destroyer of foes; by good fortune you have regained the kingdom by dharma and strength.

verses.text:
भव नस्त्वं महाराज राजेह शरदां शतम् ।
प्रजाः पालय धर्मेण यथेन्द्रस्त्रिदिवं नृप ॥

meaning.en: Be our king here, great king, for a hundred autumns, and protect the people with dharma as Indra protects heaven, lord."

verses.text:
एवं राजकुलद्वारि मङ्गलैरभिपूजितः ।
आशीर्वादान्द्विजैरुक्तान्प्रतिगृह्य समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: So honored at the door of the royal house with auspicious things, he received the blessings spoken by the brahmins on all sides.

verses.text:
प्रविश्य भवनं राजा देवराजगृहोपमम् ।
श्रुत्वा विजयसंयुक्तं रथात्पश्चादवातरत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing news bound with victory, the king entered the palace, like the house of the king of the gods, and got down from his chariot.

verses.text:
प्रविश्याभ्यन्तरं श्रीमान्दैवतान्यभिगम्य च ।
पूजयामास रत्नैश्च गन्धैर्माल्यैश्च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Entering within, the glorious king approached the deities and worshiped them everywhere with jewels, perfumes and garlands.

verses.text:
निश्चक्राम ततः श्रीमान्पुनरेव महायशाः ।
ददर्श ब्राह्मणांश्चैव सोऽभिरूपानुपस्थितान् ॥

meaning.en: Then the glorious and greatly famed one came out again and saw brahmins of fine bearing standing there.

verses.text:
स संवृतस्तदा विप्रैराशीर्वादविवक्षुभिः ।
शुशुभे विमलश्चन्द्रस्तारागणवृतो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded then by brahmins who wished to utter blessings, he shone like the spotless moon surrounded by a host of stars.

verses.text:
तान्स संपूजयामास कौन्तेयो विधिवद्द्विजान् ।
धौम्यं गुरुं पुरस्कृत्य ज्येष्ठं पितरमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Kunti's son honored those twice-born properly, putting his teacher Dhaumya and his elder, his father, first.

verses.text:
सुमनोमोदकै रत्नैर्हिरण्येन च भूरिणा ।
गोभिर्वस्त्रैश्च राजेन्द्र विविधैश्च किमिच्छकैः ॥

meaning.en: With flowers, sweets, jewels and much gold, with cows and clothes, lord of kings, and with all kinds of things they could ask for.

verses.text:
ततः पुण्याहघोषोऽभूद्दिवं स्तब्ध्वेव भारत ।
सुहृदां हर्षजननः पुण्यः श्रुतिसुखावहः ॥

meaning.en: Then the sound of "Punyaha" rose, as if filling the sky, Bharata, holy, delighting friends and pleasing to hear.

verses.text:
हंसवन्नेदुषां राजन्द्विजानां तत्र भारती ।
शुश्रुवे वेदविदुषां पुष्कलार्थपदाक्षरा ॥

meaning.en: There the speech of the Veda-knowing brahmins, resounding like swans, was heard, rich in meaning, words and syllables.

verses.text:
ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः शङ्खानां च मनोरमः ।
जयं प्रवदतां तत्र स्वनः प्रादुरभून्नृप ॥

meaning.en: Then the sound of kettledrums and lovely conches arose there, king, along with the voices of those proclaiming victory.

verses.text:
निःशब्दे च स्थिते तत्र ततो विप्रजने पुनः ।
राजानं ब्राह्मणच्छद्मा चार्वाको राक्षसोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When the brahmins had fallen quiet and stood still, the rakshasa Charvaka, disguised as a brahmin, spoke to the king.

verses.text:
तत्र दुर्योधनसखा भिक्षुरूपेण संवृतः ।
सांख्यः शिखी त्रिदण्डी च धृष्टो विगतसाध्वसः ॥

meaning.en: He was Duryodhana's friend, covered in the guise of a mendicant, a Sankhya with a topknot and a triple staff, bold and fearless.

verses.text:
वृतः सर्वैस्तदा विप्रैराशीर्वादविवक्षुभिः ।
परंसहस्रै राजेन्द्र तपोनियमसंस्थितैः ॥

meaning.en: He was surrounded by all those brahmins who wished to pronounce blessings, lord of kings, more than a thousand, who were established in austerity and discipline.

verses.text:
स दुष्टः पापमाशंसन्पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
अनामन्त्र्यैव तान्विप्रांस्तमुवाच महीपतिम् ॥

meaning.en: The wicked one, wishing evil for the great-souled Pandavas, without asking those brahmins, spoke to the king.

verses.text:
इमे प्राहुर्द्विजाः सर्वे समारोप्य वचो मयि ।
धिग्भवन्तं कुनृपतिं ज्ञातिघातिनमस्तु वै ॥

meaning.en: "All these brahmins say, laying the words on me: 'Shame on you, bad king, killer of kinsmen!'

verses.text:
किं ते राज्येन कौन्तेय कृत्वेमं ज्ञातिसंक्षयम् ।
घातयित्वा गुरूंश्चैव मृतं श्रेयो न जीवितम् ॥

meaning.en: What use to you is a kingdom, Kunti's son, having brought about this destruction of kin and killed your elders? Death is better than life."

verses.text:
इति ते वै द्विजाः श्रुत्वा तस्य घोरस्य रक्षसः ।
विव्यथुश्चुक्रुशुश्चैव तस्य वाक्यप्रधर्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of that terrible rakshasa, the brahmins were pained and cried out, overwhelmed by his speech.

verses.text:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे स च राजा युधिष्ठिरः ।
व्रीडिताः परमोद्विग्नास्तूष्णीमासन्विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then all those brahmins, and King Yudhishthira too, lord of the people, were ashamed, deeply distressed and silent.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे प्रणतस्याभियाचतः ।
प्रत्यापन्नं व्यसनिनं न मां धिक्कर्तुमर्हथ ॥

meaning.en: Be gracious to me, I bow and beg you; do not reproach me, who have fallen into misfortune and am distressed.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो राजन्ब्राह्मणास्ते सर्व एव विशां पते ।
ऊचुर्नैतद्वचोऽस्माकं श्रीरस्तु तव पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: Then, king, all those brahmins, lord of the people, said: "These are not our words; may prosperity be yours, king."

verses.text:
जज्ञुश्चैव महात्मानस्ततस्तं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
ब्राह्मणा वेदविद्वांसस्तपोभिर्विमलीकृताः ॥

meaning.en: Then those great-souled brahmins, learned in the Veda and cleansed by austerities, knew him with the eye of knowledge.

verses.text: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The brahmins said:

verses.text:
एष दुर्योधनसखा चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः ।
परिव्राजकरूपेण हितं तस्य चिकीर्षति ॥

meaning.en: This is Charvaka, a rakshasa and friend of Duryodhana, who in the form of a wandering monk wishes to do good for him.

verses.text:
न वयं ब्रूम धर्मात्मन्व्येतु ते भयमीदृशम् ।
उपतिष्ठतु कल्याणं भवन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: We do not say this, righteous soul; let such fear leave you; let welfare attend you with your brothers.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे हुंकारैः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।
निर्भर्त्सयन्तः शुचयो निजघ्नुः पापराक्षसम् ॥

meaning.en: Then all those pure brahmins, faint with anger, rebuked him with "hum" sounds and struck down the wicked rakshasa.

verses.text:
स पपात विनिर्दग्धस्तेजसा ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ।
महेन्द्राशनिनिर्दग्धः पादपोऽङ्कुरवानिव ॥

meaning.en: He fell, burned up by the power of those who speak of Brahman, like a sprouting tree burned by Indra's thunderbolt.

verses.text:
पूजिताश्च ययुर्विप्रा राजानमभिनन्द्य तम् ।
राजा च हर्षमापेदे पाण्डवः ससुहृज्जनः ॥

meaning.en: The brahmins, honored, went away after delighting the king, and the king, the Pandava, felt joy with his friends and people.

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणास्तात लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्चनीयाः सदा मम ।
एते भूमिचरा देवा वाग्विषाः सुप्रसादकाः ॥

meaning.en: Dear one, brahmins are always to be revered by me in this world; they are gods walking the earth, with poison in their speech yet very gracious.

verses.text:
पुरा कृतयुगे तात चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः ।
तपस्तेपे महाबाहो बदर्यां बहुवत्सरम् ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, in the Krita age, dear one, there was a rakshasa named Charvaka who practiced austerity for many years at Badari, mighty-armed one.

verses.text:
छन्द्यमानो वरेणाथ ब्रह्मणा स पुनः पुनः ।
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो वरयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: Pressed again and again by Brahma to choose a boon, he chose freedom from fear from all beings, Bharata.

verses.text:
द्विजावमानादन्यत्र प्रादाद्वरमनुत्तमम् ।
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यस्ततस्तस्मै जगत्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord of the world gave him the supreme boon of freedom from fear from all beings, except through insulting brahmins.

verses.text:
स तु लब्धवरः पापो देवानमितविक्रमः ।
राक्षसस्तापयामास तीव्रकर्मा महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Having got the boon, that wicked rakshasa of limitless strength and cruel deeds tormented the gods.

verses.text:
ततो देवाः समेत्याथ ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रुवन् ।
वधाय रक्षसस्तस्य बलविप्रकृतास्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods, oppressed by his power, gathered and said this to Brahma, for that rakshasa's killing.

verses.text:
तानुवाचाव्ययो देवो विहितं तत्र वै मया ।
यथास्य भविता मृत्युरचिरेणैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: The imperishable god said to them: "I have already arranged how his death will come before long, Bharata.

verses.text:
राजा दुर्योधनो नाम सखास्य भविता नृप ।
तस्य स्नेहावबद्धोऽसौ ब्राह्मणानवमंस्यते ॥

meaning.en: A king named Duryodhana will be his friend, lord; bound by affection for him, he will despise brahmins.

verses.text:
तत्रैनं रुषिता विप्रा विप्रकारप्रधर्षिताः ।
धक्ष्यन्ति वाग्बलाः पापं ततो नाशं गमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then the brahmins, angered and overcome by the insult, strong in speech, will burn up the sinner, and he will perish."

verses.text:
स एष निहतः शेते ब्रह्मदण्डेन राक्षसः ।
चार्वाको नृपतिश्रेष्ठ मा शुचो भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: That rakshasa Charvaka lies slain by the brahmins' rod of Brahman; do not grieve, best of kings, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
हतास्ते क्षत्रधर्मेण ज्ञातयस्तव पार्थिव ।
स्वर्गताश्च महात्मानो वीराः क्षत्रियपुंगवाः ॥

meaning.en: Your kinsmen were slain by kshatriya dharma, king, and those great-souled heroes, bulls among kshatriyas, have gone to heaven.

verses.text:
स त्वमातिष्ठ कल्याणं मा ते भूद्ग्लानिरच्युत ।
शत्रूञ्जहि प्रजा रक्ष द्विजांश्च प्रतिपालय ॥

meaning.en: So take up what is good; let there be no depression in you, unfallen one; slay your enemies, protect the people, and look after the brahmins.
